description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2990012008976 STARTER,ENGINE,AIR: Line 0001 Qty 20 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0075 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
